```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(yaml)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(knitr)
})
```

# M1 Cross-Trait QC Index

This index aggregates per-trait QC sidecars (`*.qc.json`) and renders the
N×N LDSC bivariate-intercept matrix that drives M2 MTAG `--overlap` and
CPASSOC sensitivity analysis.

## Section 1 — Cross-trait summary

```{r per_trait_summary}
inv_doc <- if (file.exists(params$inventory)) yaml::read_yaml(params$inventory) else list()
traits <- inv_doc$traits %||% list()

rows <- list()
qc_dir <- params$qc_log_dir
if (is.list(traits) && length(traits) > 0) {
  for (key in names(traits)) {
    e <- traits[[key]]
    qc_path <- file.path(qc_dir, paste0(key, ".qc.json"))
    qc_status <- if (!is.null(e$qc_status)) e$qc_status else "UNKNOWN"
    n_rows <- NA_integer_
    palin_pct <- NA_real_
    if (file.exists(qc_path)) {
      qc <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(qc_path), error = function(e) list())
      n_rows <- qc$n_output %||% NA
      n_in <- qc$n_input %||% NA
      n_palin <- qc$n_palindromic_dropped %||% NA
      if (!is.na(n_in) && is.numeric(n_in) && n_in > 0 && !is.na(n_palin)) {
        palin_pct <- 100 * n_palin / n_in
      }
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      key = key,
      trait = e$trait %||% NA,
      ancestry = e$ancestry %||% NA,
      consortium = e$consortium %||% NA,
      n_rows = n_rows,
      palin_pct = palin_pct,
      ldsc_intercept = e$ldsc_intercept %||% NA,
      ldsc_h2 = e$ldsc_h2 %||% NA,
      qc_status = qc_status
    )
  }
}
summary_df <- if (length(rows) > 0) do.call(rbind, rows) else data.frame()
if (nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(summary_df, digits = 4, caption = "Per-trait QC summary")
}
```

## Section 2 — LDSC bivariate-intercept heatmap (N × N)

```{r matrix_heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
mat_status <- "FAIL"
if (file.exists(params$matrix)) {
  mat <- read.table(params$matrix, sep = "\t", header = TRUE,
                    row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  mat_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(as.matrix(mat)))
  colnames(mat_long) <- c("trait_a", "trait_b", "intercept")
  mat_long$intercept <- as.numeric(as.character(mat_long$intercept))
  ggplot(mat_long, aes(x = trait_a, y = trait_b, fill = intercept)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "grey90") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                         midpoint = 0, na.value = "grey50",
                         limits = c(-1, 1), oob = scales::squish) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = sprintf("LDSC bivariate-intercept matrix (%d × %d)",
                         nrow(mat), ncol(mat)),
         x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "intercept")
  mat_status <- "PASS"
}
```

* **Matrix status**: `r mat_status`

## Section 3 — Self-consistency warnings (Pitfall #8)

```{r warnings}
if (file.exists(params$warnings)) {
  w <- jsonlite::fromJSON(params$warnings)
  cat("**n_traits**:", w$n_traits %||% NA, "  \n")
  cat("**n_pairs_filled**:", w$n_pairs_filled %||% NA, "  \n")
  cat("**Symmetry warnings**:", length(w$symmetry_warnings %||% list()), "  \n")
  cat("**Heuristic warnings**:", length(w$heuristic_warnings %||% list()), "  \n")
  if (length(w$symmetry_warnings %||% list()) > 0) {
    cat("\n### Symmetry warnings\n")
    for (msg in w$symmetry_warnings) cat("- ", msg, "\n")
  }
  if (length(w$heuristic_warnings %||% list()) > 0) {
    cat("\n### Heuristic warnings\n")
    for (msg in w$heuristic_warnings) cat("- ", msg, "\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("warnings JSON missing — gate FAIL")
}
```

## Section 4 — Deferred cells

```{r deferred}
deferred_paths <- list.files("data/raw/sumstats_v2", pattern = "\\.deferred$",
                             recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
if (length(deferred_paths) > 0) {
  defer_df <- data.frame(deferred_marker = deferred_paths)
  knitr::kable(defer_df, caption = sprintf("Deferred raw cells (n=%d)",
                                            length(deferred_paths)))
} else {
  cat("(no deferred markers found)\n")
}
```
